name: Text-to-speech (TTS / TTS Nuance) app enable
description: SWT 'application coded' enable bit that gates whether the text-to-speech (TTS and TTS Nuance) speech synthesis component is active. Firmware-traced: queried in FUN_002f58c4 switch cases 5 (TTS) and 0xD (TTS Nuance). Requires Business nav (606) or Professional nav (609) or MFL (249).

name: ISpeech voice recognition app (SWT)
description: Software token (SWT) enable bit for the ISpeech or ISpeech-Nuance voice recognition application. When inactive, the ISpeech component is treated as not coded and is disabled.

name: A4A app SWT enable
description: SWT (Software Token / software-coded) enable bit for the A4A (Apps for Auto / smartphone projection) application. Decoded by the firmware switch for A4A app presence; a separate gate from the coding-only A4A bit at byte 107.

name: USB profile directory name
description: Selects the brand-specific subdirectory name used by the Portation Master when importing/exporting user profiles to/from a USB drive. The directory name corresponds to the vehicle brand.

name: Software update: shutdown timeout enable
description: When enabled, a watchdog shutdown timer is active during software update (SWUP) operations to prevent the vehicle being stranded with a partially updated system if the process stalls.

name: Software update: vehicle speed lock
description: When enabled, software update installation is prevented while the vehicle is moving above a threshold speed, reducing driver distraction risk during update. Always active (no FA gate).

name: Software updates master enable
description: Master enable flag for all software update (SWUP/KISU) functionality. When disabled, no over-the-air or USB software updates can be initiated regardless of other SWUP settings.

name: Engineering software updates enable
description: Allows installation of engineering/development-signed software packages, beyond normal production updates. intended for BMW engineering vehicles.

name: Software update: require user confirmation
description: When enabled, the driver must explicitly confirm before a software update is installed. When disabled, updates install automatically without user interaction.

name: Software update source: USB
description: Enables USB mass storage as an allowed software update source (KISU/SWUP via USB). Requires navigation, telephony, or telematics SA option.

name: Software update source: online/OTA
description: Enables online/over-the-air update delivery as an allowed software update source. Requires 6AE (TeleServices).

name: Personal profile master
description: Makes the head unit the master control unit for personal profiles, storing them and coordinating profile changes with the rest of the car. Leave it unchanged; other control units rely on it.

name: Profile reset to defaults
description: Lets the driver reset a personal profile to its factory default settings from the profile menu, clearing the preferences saved in it.

name: Profile copying
description: Lets the personal profile system copy profiles, so the settings saved in one profile can be reused in another without setting them up again.

name: Profile export and import
description: Turns on profile export and import, which lets personal profile settings be saved to and loaded from external storage such as a USB stick. It's the main switch above the other profile transfer options.

name: Allow temporary profile switch
description: Permits a temporary (session-only) switch to a different user profile. The temporary profile reverts when the ignition cycle ends, without overwriting the stored profile.

name: Allow permanent profile switch
description: Enables the ability to permanently switch the active user profile, persisting the selection across ignition cycles.

name: Profile settings from mobile device
description: Lets the head unit receive personal profile settings from a connected mobile device and apply them to a profile. When disabled, such transfers are ignored.

name: Approved-device check for profiles
description: Before accepting profile settings from a mobile device, checks it against the list of approved devices and asks the driver to confirm one that isn't on the list. When disabled, the check is skipped.

name: Car-sharing profile mode
description: Turns on the personal profile system's car-sharing mode, which handles profiles for a changing group of drivers in shared cars.

name: Profile 2-second timer
description: Timing setting for the personal profile system that turns on a 2-second timer used when handling profile changes. Best left unchanged.

name: Vehicle series code (Baureihe)
description: Identifies the BMW vehicle series (Baureihe) to which this head unit is coded. Used by the portation master to select series-specific profile and behaviour defaults.

name: HDCP copy protection
description: Turns on HDCP (High-bandwidth Digital Content Protection) on the head unit's digital video connections, the copy protection that protected video content requires. Best left unchanged.

name: Vehicle state concept
description: Tells the head unit which power-state model the car uses: the conventional model based on ignition terminals, or the newer park, reside and drive model (PWF). The personal profile system relies on it to time profile actions. Set it to match the car.
